assignments.task_summary: Implement one version-change publication boundary and prove a reader cannot receive a V1 projection labeled V2.
Build and execute one small counterexample model comparing the retained in-process projection boundary with a hypothetical extracted boundary.
Implement and execute one existing local configuration switch back to the reference public projection while requests are in flight.
Execute one final counterexample against the selected public projection implementation and defend retaining or removing the optional adapter.

Independently reproduce the frozen local candidate and execute the separate OPS-SNAPSHOT integrity smoke and FRONT-HISTORY browser smoke, investigating only the first concrete mismatch. Keep fixture-lane identities explicit; do not treat their different counts as one integrated snapshot.
Translate an unfamiliar bounded worker-priority requirement into an executable contract and challenge it with a starvation counterexample.
Implement only the priority-selection seam specified on day 178 against the existing real database claim interface.
Author and execute adversarial tests for one missing priority-claim invariant and repair only the demonstrated defect or missing regression.

Independently diagnose an unfamiliar incident from its observed owned-history timeout and a known-good control, author a minimal reproducer and execute one falsifying counterexperiment. The selected cause is not disclosed; do not attempt a broad repair today.
Implement one minimal repair for the diagnosed day 181 fault and compare it with the failing candidate under the same frozen schedule.
Perform a timed SQL/reliability mock by implementing a tiny claim predicate, challenging it with a late-worker counterexample, then testing one lesson from the debrief.
Run the already-prepared bounded local rollback/recovery demonstration and reconcile the displayed claims with exact observed evidence; implement no new feature.
Implement a three-way topic-suggestion decision table plus ABSTAIN for a human-reviewed support triage task; keep eligibility, pricing, coverage and payment decisions outside its output.
Implement a label-rubric validator that keeps single-intent topic labels separate from ambiguous and prohibited requests.
Author the deterministic corpus builder from a learner-written matrix of twelve template families and three topic intents, preserving group, entity and label provenance.
Implement a split allocator and overlap checker using source/template groups rather than row-level shuffling.
Write a small keyword baseline with explicit conflict and no-match abstention; evaluate it only on training examples and a tiny development smoke set.
Implement confusion counts, abstention coverage and selective error with explicit denominators for the baseline.
Add mutation-resistant tests for dropped predictions, duplicated examples and all-abstain groups in the metric calculator.
Implement a development-only threshold evaluator over fixed confidence scores and select by an explicit safety-first rule.
Implement a grouped bootstrap summary of a fixed prediction table without converting uncertainty into a model-quality claim.
Implement a cost-aware comparison of a majority-topic baseline and a more selective predictor on an imbalanced synthetic slice.
Locate and repair a seeded split-audit defect that hashes raw strings but misses punctuation and case variants across partitions.
Implement an evaluation specification validator that freezes dataset, group split, metrics, thresholds and forbidden outputs before model results exist.
Implement and execute a resource preflight for the chosen small text-classification experiment, without training the full candidate yet.
Implement a dataset release checker that reproduces corpus/split digests and validates rubric, license and training eligibility records.
Implement the feature pipeline fit/transform boundary with a training-fitted vocabulary and explicit empty-document behavior.
Fit one real MultinomialNB classifier with alpha 1.0 on the frozen 144 training rows and save its fitted parameters with the feature configuration.
Run the trained classifier on the 42-row development partition and compare its errors with the frozen rule baseline using the common metric code.
Implement an error-taxonomy annotator for at most twelve development failures and test that each explanation is traceable to actual predictions.
Rebuild the vectorizer/classifier composition from its public contract and blank composition seam, then compare predictions with the frozen candidate.
Train exactly one alpha 0.5 alternative against alpha 1.0 and compare development results under the frozen cost and safety criteria.
Apply the predeclared threshold search to the chosen real candidate and freeze the selected threshold or reject the candidate.
Evaluate the frozen model-plus-abstention policy and the rule baseline on the untouched 42-row test partition, emitting a pass/reject result without tuning.
Implement a read-only extractive help baseline that filters source eligibility before ranking and returns an exact source span or abstention.
Implement and evaluate a bounded lexical ranker on the authorized baseline corpus with learner-authored relevance labels.
Run matched bounded repetitions of the selected small-model fit/predict path and the deterministic topic baseline, recording failures and resource limits.
Implement and execute one bounded inference-capability check against an already available authorized local model, or record model inference blocked while executing the extractive baseline.
Implement the request assembler for the existing read-only inference port with source, character, output and deadline limits plus a no-model fallback.
Implement a citation-span verifier that accepts only exact spans of the authorized source revision and routes unsupported claims to review or abstention.
Find and repair a seeded publication bug where an answer assembled before source revocation is displayed after the authorization generation changes.
Implement the Java read-only topic-suggestion DTO decoder for predictions from the actual trained candidate, rejecting malformed and authority-bearing fields.
Implement one state transition that keeps the existing manual/extractive help usable when the optional topic or inference path fails.
Execute the prepared topic-suggestion plus authorized-evidence slice and implement a receipt checker joining real training, evaluation and application-boundary observations.
Implement a lineage manifest builder binding allowed dataset, split, preprocessing, code, fitted model, threshold and evaluation receipt identities.
Implement a bounded reproduction runner that trains the selected configuration from the released dataset in a clean approved local process.
Implement the existing trusted-artifact loader preflight so only the locally produced, allowlisted candidate with matching lineage can be loaded.
Write a promotion eligibility function over actual evaluation, lineage, trust and resource receipts, returning explicit rejection reasons.
Strengthen the promotion gate with tests that swap an excellent evaluation receipt onto a different model, threshold or dataset candidate.
Implement a shadow replay joiner comparing active baseline and candidate on the same 20 synthetic requests without changing the user-visible decision.
